meta.note: SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH for the Barkpark Unified Aesthetic. HAND-EDIT THIS FILE ONLY. Every surface token (Studio CSS vars, web @theme, Go semrole/taskboard artifact, paper-surface.css, pdrender) is GENERATED from here by W1.2 emitters — never edit generated output; regenerate it. Language-neutral: colors are HSL channels (H S% L%) so per-surface emitters can convert and the '/ alpha' soft-tint machinery + WCAG gate survive.
meta.colorFormat: HSL channels 'H S% L%' (no hsl() wrapper) so emitters can splice into hsl(<channels> / <alpha>) for soft tints
meta.outOfScope: emitters, drift gate, surface adoption (W1.2 / W2+)

_convention.form: Each role has { light, dark } as HSL channels. softAlpha derives status soft-tint fills: hsl(<role channels> / <softAlpha[theme]>).

strongAlpha._note: warn carries a -strong variant in the cloud source; emitters derive it from this alpha over the warn channels.

primary-hover._role: evergreen brand, hover tone — darker in light, lighter in dark (standard hover shift)

accent._role: warm amber, decorative — NOT a status

reading-accent._role: warm reading accent — the paper terracotta, tokenized

status._note: The four semantic roles ok/info/warn/danger. 'ok' green is health/live-dot and is DELIBERATELY distinct from lifecycle 'done' teal (see lifecycle section). Emitters expose --ok/--info/--warn/--danger and derive -soft (softAlpha) fills; warn also gets -strong (strongAlpha).

onStatus._note: On-fill foregrounds for the four status roles — the white text that sits ON a filled --ok/--warn/--danger/--info chip. Studio-only (emitted by studioBlock ONLY; no other surface consumes them). danger-fg is asymmetric (98% light / 100% dark, mirroring the live shadcn --destructive-fg); the rest are pure white both themes.

studioChrome._note: Studio-only zinc/chrome ladder aliases (shadcn zinc shades that have no exact base-role token). Values are HSL channels 'H S% L%' OR a 'var(--role)' reference where an emitted base role already carries the exact value (border-muted light = --border; fg-accent dark = --text). Emitted by studioBlock ONLY. Consumed via var(--bg-accent|--border-muted|--fg-dim|--fg-accent) across Studio chrome.

presence._note: Categorical presence-avatar palette (8 fixed hues, hex, theme-invariant). NOT a status role — a phash2 of the user id indexes into this list, so the hue IS categorical identity, not semantics. Emitted as an Elixir VALUE list (BarkparkWeb.Studio.TokensGen.presence_palette/0), NOT a CSS var — the concrete hex is picked/compared at runtime. Mirrors presence_state.ex @colors 1:1.

sheetCf._note: Categorical Sheets swatch palettes (hex, theme-invariant). PERSISTED DATA: a chosen swatch is stored on the cell/rule/tab (phx-value-bg / set_tab_color) and compared for selection state — the concrete hex MUST survive, so these emit as Elixir VALUE lists (BarkparkWeb.Studio.TokensGen.sheet_cf_backgrounds/0 + sheet_tab_colors/0), never CSS vars. 'background' = the pastel cell/rule fills; 'tab' = the saturated per-tab dots (read best more vivid). Mirror sheet_grid.ex 1:1.

authButton._note: Login/auth-page (session_html.ex) button fills — DECOUPLED from --primary so the fill stays a deeper green carrying light text (mirrors the Cloud dashboard). Emitted ONLY into session_html.ex's page-scoped .bp-auth block. bg/fg light are var(--primary)/var(--primary-fg) passthroughs; bgHover carries the auth-specific hover tone; dark bg is the standalone deep-green fill with white text.

statusChrome._note: Public status page (status_controller.ex) self-contained :root chrome palette. Standalone page rendered WITHOUT the Studio layout — the emitted :root tokens never cascade in — so it carries its own bg/fg/muted/card/line, theme-aware via prefers-color-scheme. Bespoke zinc shades (no exact base-role token); emitted ONLY into status_controller.ex's page-scoped block as HEX (byte-preserving the exact chrome).

statusHealth._note: Public status page health-severity DATA tones (status_controller.ex @labels + component dots). These convey OUTAGE SEVERITY as inline style hex — categorical DATA, not a CSS role. partial_outage (#ea580c) is an OUT-OF-MODEL minted tone sitting between warn-amber (degraded #d97706) and danger-red (major_outage #dc2626) — deliberately NOT recolored onto --warn/--danger so the severity distinction survives. 'unknown' is the neutral gray fallback for an unrecognised status. Emitted as an Elixir VALUE map (BarkparkWeb.Studio.TokensGen.status_health/0 + status_health_unknown/0).

errorPage._note: Error page (error_html.ex 404/500/…) FIXED-DARK palette. INTENTIONALLY always dark (a stark error card), NO theme switch — de-literalized WITHOUT becoming theme-aware (a theme-aware repoint would flip it light and break the intent). Emitted ONLY into error_html.ex's page-scoped :root block as single (non-theme) HEX values, byte-preserving.

readerInfo._note: The /sheets/:slug reader (sheets.html.heex) info-blue link + focus ring. Self-contained parchment reader (root tokens don't cascade), so it carries its own --info: a WCAG-safe darker blue-600 (#2563eb, clears 4.5:1 on the near-white parchment) in light, lifting to the info-role blue-500 (#3b82f6 = status.info) on the dark parchment. Semantic info-blue (NOT categorical). Emitted ONLY into sheets.html.heex's page-scoped :root/@media-dark block as HEX.

reading.stack: "Iowan Old Style", "Palatino Linotype", Palatino, Charter, Georgia, "Source Serif 4", serif
reading._role: serif prose on the paper surface

chrome._note: UI chrome scale (Inter). Studio / web / TUI status text.

reading._note: Prose scale on the paper surface (serif). headingWeight applies to h1-h3.

elevation._note: Shadow ladder. Values are the LIGHT-theme shadows; dark is retuned per surface by emitters (deeper, lower-alpha). Recorded as CSS box-shadow strings.

lifecycle._note: Task-lifecycle vocabulary. RECONCILED 1:1 with internal/semrole/semrole.go (taskLifecycleRoles) + internal/taskboard (theme.go colors, components.go StatusGlyph, spinner.go asciiGlyph/frames, board.go life* consts). role '' = neutral/uncoloured (never a guess). 'color' here is the taskboard glyph hue (adaptive light/dark) and is INDEPENDENT of the semantic status palette above — notably 'done'/'closed' use TEAL, distinct from status.ok GREEN. Emitters that need the semantic role tone read color.status via 'role'.

_default._note: unknown lifecycle degrades to the neutral dot

in_progress._escalation: board-only: warms info -> warn -> danger as the 5-min claim lease burns

done._color_note: TEAL — deliberately distinct from status.ok green (#10b981/#34d399). Finished work recedes.
